pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.intro: Generate a one-time code, scan it from the ConductLoop iOS app. The phone then connects to this machine over your network. Your data never leaves this device.
pair.remote_warn_b: on this computer and your phone (same account). The QR already includes your Tailscale address, so the app connects from anywhere — no ports, no cloud.
pair.no_lan: No LAN address detected — is OPS_ALLOW_MOBILE=1 set?
pair.revoke_confirm: Revoke this device? It will lose access immediately.
pair.net_note: Off unless you turn it on. When on, ConductLoop also answers on your local network (port 7777) so a paired phone can reach it; every request still needs that phone's token. It takes effect when ConductLoop restarts.
pair.net_on: On: devices on your network can reach this computer.
pair.net_off: Off: only this computer can reach ConductLoop.
pair.net_restart_on: It will turn on when ConductLoop restarts.
pair.net_restart_off: It will turn off when ConductLoop restarts.
pair.net_env: Set by OPS_ALLOW_MOBILE for this server.
pair.net_unknown: Could not read the network setting.
pair.net_could_not_save: Could not save the network setting: {msg}
pair.net_warn: ⚠ The phone can't reach this computer while network access is off. Turn it on above and restart ConductLoop.
